title: Shree TNB Polymers IPO Details
intro:
Shree TNB Polymers IPO is a book build issue of ₹31.80 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 60.00 lakh shares of ₹31.80 crore.

Shree TNB Polymers IPO opens for subscription on Sep 28, 2026 and closes on Oct 5, 2026. The allotment for the Shree TNB Polymers IPO is expected to be finalized on Oct 6, 2026. Shree TNB Polymers IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Oct 8, 2026.

Shree TNB Polymers IPO is set issue price band at ₹50 to ₹53 per share. The lot size for an application is 2,000 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,12,000 (4,000 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (6,000 shares), amounting to ₹3,18,000.

Corporate Makers Capital Ltd. is the book running lead manager and MUFG Intime India Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is Asnani Stock Broker Pvt.Ltd.

Refer to Shree TNB Polymers IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated on March 07, 2007, Shree TNB Polymers Limited is a Silvassa-based polymer manufacturing company specializing in piping systems and plastic solutions. The Company’s products are designed to meet the evolving demands of critical applications such as irrigation and agriculture, potable water supply schemes, sewerage and drainage systems, telecom cable protection, construction, and industrial usage.

The company offers a diversified product portfolio comprising HDPE pipes & fittings, PP (Polypropylene) and PPH (Polypropylene Homopolymer) pipes & fittings, Double Wall Corrugated (DWC) pipes, sprinkler pipes, drip irrigation systems, solid industrial sheets and Well pack sheets for packaging and industrial applications.

It operates two manufacturing facilities at Silvassa across 23,028 sq. mtrs. with a combined installed capacity of 24,000 MT per annum, supported by in-house quality testing laboratories and BIS/ISO certifications across multiple Indian Standards. As of March 31, 2026, the company employed 318 full-time employees and maintained a 325+ dealer/distributor network across India, with exports to UAE, Sri Lanka, Oman, and Germany.
As at July 31, 2026, we had 298 full-time employees and 39 contract labourers.
strengths: Strong promoter-driven business with deep market understanding and relationships. Established presence in the polymers/trading/manufacturing segment with long-standing industry experience.
Diversified product portfolio catering to multiple industrial applications
Cordial relationship with the customers/ dealers/ distributors and established manufacturing facilities

faqs.question: How to apply in Shree TNB Polymers IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Shree TNB Polymers IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Shree TNB Polymers IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Shree TNB Polymers IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Shree TNB Polymers IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.answer: You can apply in Shree TNB Polymers IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account.
